subject: Malaysia M-340 TiO2 for Italmaster's white-masterbatch review
body:
Italmaster blends pre-dispersed single-pigment granules before extrusion for its masterbatch production.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-340 rutile TiO2 powder. Its TDS lists high-concentration masterbatch and alumina surface treatment, with typical TiO2 content of 97%.

If your team also qualifies TiO2 powders, may I send the M-340 technical sheet for your white-masterbatch review?
